subject: Finlytics POC: next steps & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC: next steps & success criteria

Thanks again for the call this morning, Daniel — great to meet you and Rachel. Per our discussion, here is a concise recap and proposed plan for the 4-week POC so we can align on success criteria, responsibilities, and timeline.

Summary of objectives:
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost improvements on your real workloads
- Confirm model parity on key prompts (accuracy and hallucination rates)
- Measure end-to-end integration (API, auth, and data controls)

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) 99th-percentile generation latency < 350ms for 512-token contexts on our dedicated profile
2) Token cost reduction >= 30% vs your current baseline over a typical day
3) No critical accuracy regressions on the 50-prompt eval set (<= 5% drop in pass rate)
4) Integration smoke test (auth, retries, observability hooks) completed by your infra team

POC plan & timelines:
- Week 0 (this week): Prep + access (sample dataset, allowlist, test credentials)
- Week 1: Baseline measurements + small scale runs (Marissa/Marcus own test plan)
- Week 2: Optimization (batching, quant profiles) + run evals (Monica leads)
- Week 3: Scale tests + cost analysis + integration validation
- Week 4: Readout and next-step recommendations

Ownership (suggested):
- Finlytics technical lead: Rachel Lee (cc'd)
- Redwood engagement lead: Marissa Cole
- Redwood CS/infra: Monica Patel

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD?):
- Confirm the success criteria above (or propose edits)
- Provide a sample dataset and an engineer to receive allowlist details
- Confirm kickoff slot: Wed 2027-03-17 10:00am PT

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Plan-v1.pdf, POC-checklist.xlsx (detailed tasks & timelines).

Thanks — I can update the plan quickly based on your feedback.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

We have SOC 2 summary and network requirements here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDEFgHIjkL (read-only). I'll also start a DocuSign SOW placeholder so we have mutual commitments for the reserved test capacity — sending link now.

- Update POC plan (v1.1) with the new latency ramp and the eval items (attached)

- Create the kickoff calendar invite for Wed 3/17 10am PT

If Rachel or Daniel can confirm the sample dataset delivery ETA (this week? earliest Mon EOD), we can start provisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
